description: Edit a Google Slides deck in place from the command line: pull it to editable local SML, change it (semantic selectors, roles, components, images, layout), preview an exact diff, and push batchUpdates back to the SAME deck. Use for any task that creates or restyles Google Slides while keeping them native and editable — new slides, deck-wide restyles, media/galleries, cross-deck theme transfer — instead of generating an image or a throwaway .pptx.
